body.title: Pitch-Off
body.text: Pairs. Your phone shows your product. 30 seconds to pitch it to the table like your Series A depends on it. Table votes by pointing.
cues: Salik for queues — pay 4 AED to skip any line in Dubai
Karak subscription drone — hot chai to your window at 5pm sharp
AC jacket — personal climate control for mall-to-car journeys
Habibi Translate — earbuds that convert what you said into what you meant
Valet for beaches — a man parks your towel at the perfect spot
Iftar alarm — an app that physically stops you from snacking at 6:57pm

body.title: Pitch-Off · round two
body.text: Swap partners. New product on your phone. Same rules: 30 seconds, full conviction, table votes.
cues: Grandma-as-a-Service — video call a stern grandmother to guilt you into anything
Metro seat futures — trade guaranteed rush-hour seats like stocks
Shisha smoke ring NFT camera — mint your best ring before it fades
Desert GPS for feelings — tells you exactly how lost you are, emotionally
Reverse Careem — a driver arrives and convinces you to cancel your plans
Brunch insurance — full refund if the eggs benedict disappoints

body.text: One story, built one sentence at a time around the table. Your phone shows ONE secret word — you must smuggle it into your sentence. Rawi starts: 'It was 47 degrees the day everything changed at the Global Village...'

body.title: Sound Only
body.text: One performer reads their phone, then everyone's phones go FACE DOWN. Perform the sound. No words. The table guesses out loud.
